tips.text: Collect every material first, then queue all four components at once for one 12-hour wait instead of four.
Ignore old Voidrig guides; the recipe was cut down and they list ingredients and rank gates it no longer needs.
Skip Necraloid standing; the quest already mails every blueprint, and ranking Loid is the most expensive path.
Treat the Entrati standing as standing you want anyway for Helminth, Xaku and kitguns, not as a one-mech farm.
